description: A table whose header cell spans two columns (colspan), with a synthetic `graphics` border (4 ruling lines) around it standing in for the PDF's real table rules. graphics::detect_table_regions (Stage 1b) now detects this as a Table from its ruling lines without any vision model. TEDS-Struct's topology-mismatch penalty for the merged cell itself is future work once a table-structure predictor exists to score against.
